source.text: הָיְתָ֣ה עָלַי֮ יַד־יְהוָה֒ וַיּוֹצִאֵ֤נִי בְר֨וּחַ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַיְנִיחֵ֖נִי בְּת֣וֹךְ הַבִּקְעָ֑ה וְהִ֖יא מְלֵאָ֥ה עֲצָמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: There was on me [the] hand of Yahweh, and he brought me out by [the] Spirit of Yahweh and set me down in the middle of the valley, and it [was] full of bones.

en.L: The hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was upon me, and by the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought me out and set me down in the valley's midst; and it [was] full of bones.
en.B: The hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came on me, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} carried me out by the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and put me down in the middle of the valley. It was full of bones.
en.R: The power of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came on me. By {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} took me out and put me down in the middle of a valley. The valley was full of bones.

fr.L: La main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut sur moi, et par l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me fit sortir et me déposa au milieu de la vallée ; et elle [était] pleine d’ossements.
fr.B: La main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} vint sur moi, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me transporta par l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et me déposa au milieu de la vallée. Elle était pleine d’ossements.
fr.R: La puissance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est venue sur moi. Par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a emmené et m’a déposé au milieu d’une vallée. La vallée était pleine d’ossements.

es.L: La mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estuvo sobre mí, y por el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} me sacó y me puso en medio del valle; y este [estaba] lleno de huesos.
es.B: La mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino sobre mí, y por el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} me sacó y me dejó en medio del valle. Estaba lleno de huesos.
es.R: El poder {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino sobre mí. Por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me sacó y me dejó en medio de un valle. El valle estaba lleno de huesos.

sw.L: Mkono wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulikuwa juu yangu, naye akanitoa kwa Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaniweka katikati ya bonde; nalo [lilikuwa] limejaa mifupa.
sw.B: Mkono wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukanijia, naye akanichukua kwa Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuniweka katikati ya bonde. Bonde hilo lilikuwa limejaa mifupa.
sw.R: Nguvu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikanijia. Kwa Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akanitoa, akaniweka katikati ya bonde. Bonde hilo lilikuwa limejaa mifupa.

vi.L: Tay của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trên tôi, và bởi Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đem tôi ra và đặt tôi xuống ở giữa thung lũng; và nó đầy xương.
vi.B: Tay của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đặt trên tôi, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dùng Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đem tôi đi, đặt tôi xuống giữa thung lũng. Thung lũng ấy đầy xương.
vi.R: Quyền năng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến trên tôi. Bởi Thần Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đem tôi ra và đặt tôi xuống giữa một thung lũng. Thung lũng ấy đầy những xương.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 손이 내 위에 있었다. 그분께서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영으로 나를 데리고 나가셔서 골짜기 한가운데에 내려놓으셨는데, 그곳은 뼈로 가득[했다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 손이 나에게 임했다. 그분께서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영으로 나를 데리고 나가셔서 골짜기 한가운데에 내려놓으셨다. 그 골짜기는 뼈로 가득했다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 능력이 나에게 내렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 영으로 나를 데리고 나가셔서 어느 골짜기 한가운데에 내려놓으셨다. 그 골짜기에는 뼈가 가득했다.

decisions.choice: the hand of the LORD was upon me: the LORD's power took hold of me
decisions.reason: See 1:3. The phrase opens a new vision, as in 8:1 and 40:1.

decisions.choice: by the Spirit of the LORD: the LORD's Spirit carries Ezekiel
decisions.reason: As in 3:12-14; 8:3 and 11:1, 24, the Spirit lifts and carries Ezekiel in the vision (see 2:2). The word *ruach* will be used ten times in this passage, in its three senses: Spirit, breath and wind (see verse 5).

decisions.choice: the valley full of bones: a battlefield of the unburied dead
decisions.reason: The article ("the valley") may point to the plain where Ezekiel saw the glory in 3:22-23. The bones lie scattered and unburied, like those of an army killed in battle (verse 9, "these slain"). To be left unburied was a curse (Deuteronomy 28:26; Jeremiah 8:1-2).

decisions.choice: the hand of the LORD was upon me (L); came on me (B); the power of the LORD came on me (R); Spirit, capitalized
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this formula and for *ruach* where the Spirit lifts or carries Ezekiel (2:2). Readable names the LORD as the subject for clarity. The vision is narrative, so its dialogue takes double quotation marks, by the rule set for Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "la main du SEIGNEUR fut sur moi" (L); "vint sur moi" (B); "la puissance du SEIGNEUR est venue sur moi" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and 2 Kings 3:15. Ezekiel tells his vision in the first person: passé simple at L and B ("il me fit sortir"), passé composé at R ("il m'a emmené"), through verse 10.

decisions.choice: "la mano del SEÑOR estuvo sobre mí" (L); "vino sobre mí" (B); "El poder del SEÑOR vino sobre mí" (R); "Espíritu", capitalized
decisions.reason: The formula as the terms note sets it (2 Kings 3:15); God's Spirit is capitalized.

decisions.choice: "mkono wa BWANA ulikuwa juu yangu" (L); "mkono wa BWANA ukanijia" (B); "nguvu ya BWANA ikanijia" (R)
decisions.reason: The Ezekiel formula as the term sheet and 2 Kings 3:15 have it; the vision is told as narrative with -li- and then -ka-, and "he" is carried by the verb, so it takes no deity_pronoun span. This passage (37:1-14) is drafted from the Hebrew and the gloss, away from the familiar Swahili wording.

decisions.choice: "tay của CHÚA ở trên tôi" (L) / "tay của CHÚA đặt trên tôi" (B) / "quyền năng của CHÚA đến trên tôi" (R); "Thần Linh của CHÚA"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for the idiom (as 2 Kings 3:15) and for God's Spirit. This chapter is drafted from the Hebrew and the gloss, not from the familiar 1926 wording ("trũng", "hài cốt"), so it says "thung lũng" and "xương".

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 손이 내 위에 있었다" (L); "…손이 나에게 임했다" (B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 능력이 나에게 내렸다" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for "the hand of the LORD was on me", as 2 Kings 3:15 and the earlier visions of Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영", "그분의 영" for the Spirit of the LORD; the Spirit's acts take -시-
decisions.reason: God's Spirit in the prophets is "영", with 성령 kept for the New Testament, and takes the honorific as from 2:2 on.

source.text: וְהֶעֱבִירַ֥נִי עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם סָבִ֣יב׀סָבִ֑יב וְהִנֵּ֨ה רַבּ֤וֹת מְאֹד֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַבִּקְעָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֖ה יְבֵשׁ֥וֹת מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made me pass by them all around, all around; and look, very many [were] on the face of the valley, and look, very dry.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} led me around among them, all around; and look, [there were] very many on the surface of the valley, and look, [they were] very dry.
en.B: He led me back and forth among them, and I saw that there were a great many of them on the floor of the valley, and they were very dry.
en.R: He led me all around among the bones. There were a great many of them on the ground in the valley, and they were very dry.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me fit passer auprès d’eux, tout autour, tout autour ; et voici, [ils étaient] très nombreux sur la surface de la vallée, et voici, [ils étaient] très secs.
fr.B: Il me fit passer en tous sens au milieu d’eux, et je vis qu’il y en avait une très grande quantité sur le sol de la vallée, et qu’ils étaient tout à fait secs.
fr.R: Il m’a fait faire le tour au milieu des ossements. Il y en avait énormément sur le sol de la vallée, et ils étaient très secs.

es.L: Y me hizo pasar entre ellos alrededor, todo alrededor; y he aquí, [eran] muchísimos sobre la superficie del valle, y he aquí, [estaban] muy secos.
es.B: Me hizo pasar de un lado a otro entre ellos, y vi que había muchísimos en el suelo del valle, y que estaban muy secos.
es.R: Me llevó por todas partes entre los huesos. Había muchísimos en el suelo del valle, y estaban muy secos.

sw.L: Akanipitisha kando yake pande zote, pande zote; na tazama, [ilikuwa] mingi sana juu ya uso wa bonde, na tazama, [ilikuwa] mikavu sana.
sw.B: Akaniongoza huku na huku katikati yake, nami nikaona kwamba ilikuwa mingi mno juu ya ardhi ya bonde, nayo ilikuwa mikavu sana.
sw.R: Akanizungusha kila mahali katikati ya mifupa hiyo. Ilikuwa mingi mno juu ya ardhi ya bonde, nayo ilikuwa mikavu kabisa.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn tôi đi quanh giữa chúng, khắp chung quanh; và nầy, [có] rất nhiều trên mặt thung lũng, và nầy, [chúng] rất khô.
vi.B: Ngài dẫn tôi đi qua đi lại giữa các xương ấy, và tôi thấy có rất nhiều xương trên mặt thung lũng, và chúng rất khô.
vi.R: Ngài dẫn tôi đi khắp chung quanh giữa các xương ấy. Có rất nhiều xương trên mặt đất trong thung lũng, và chúng đã khô lắm rồi.

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 나를 그것들 사이로 두루, 두루 지나가게 하셨다. 보라, 골짜기 바닥에 [뼈가] 매우 많았고, 보라, [그것들은] 매우 말라 있었다.
ko.B: 그분께서 나를 그 뼈들 사이로 이리저리 지나가게 하셨다. 보니, 골짜기 바닥에 뼈가 아주 많았는데, 모두 바싹 말라 있었다.
ko.R: 그분께서 나를 데리고 뼈들 사이를 두루 다니셨다. 골짜기 바닥에는 뼈가 아주 많았고, 모두 바싹 말라 있었다.

decisions.choice: very many and very dry: long dead, beyond all hope
decisions.reason: The bones have lain there a long time. Nothing in them suggests that life could return (verse 11). The word "very" is repeated to stress it.

decisions.choice: led me back and forth (B); all around (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats "all around". Literal keeps "all around"; Balanced and Readable give its sense. Literal keeps "look" twice for the Hebrew *hinneh*, which marks what Ezekiel saw; Balanced says "I saw".

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הֲתִחְיֶ֖ינָה הָעֲצָמ֣וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וָאֹמַ֕ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, Son of man, will these bones live? And I said, Lord Yahweh, you know.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" And I said, "Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know."
en.B: He asked me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" I answered, "Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, only {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know."
en.R: He asked me, "Son of man, can these bones come back to life?" I answered, "Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, only {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know that."

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me dit : « Fils d’homme, ces ossements peuvent-ils vivre ? » Et je dis : « Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le sais. »
fr.B: Il me demanda : « Fils d’homme, ces ossements peuvent-ils revivre ? » Je répondis : « Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul le sais. »
fr.R: Il m’a demandé : « Fils d’homme, est-ce que ces ossements peuvent revenir à la vie ? » J’ai répondu : « Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul le sais. »

es.L: Y me dijo: «Hijo de hombre, ¿vivirán estos huesos?». Y yo dije: «Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [lo] sabes».
es.B: Me preguntó: «Hijo de hombre, ¿pueden vivir estos huesos?». Le respondí: «Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, solo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} lo sabes».
es.R: Me preguntó: «Hijo de hombre, ¿pueden volver a la vida estos huesos?». Le respondí: «Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, solo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} sabes eso».

sw.L: Akaniambia, "Mwana wa binadamu, je, mifupa hii inaweza kuishi?" Nami nikasema, "Ee Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unajua."
sw.B: Akaniuliza, "Mwana wa binadamu, je, mifupa hii inaweza kuwa hai?" Nikajibu, "Ee Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} tu unayejua."
sw.R: Akaniuliza, "Mwana wa binadamu, je, mifupa hii inaweza kuwa hai tena?" Nikajibu, "Ee Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} peke {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ndiye unayejua jambo hilo."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán với tôi: "Hỡi con người, những xương này có thể sống được chăng?" Và tôi thưa: "Lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết."
vi.B: Ngài hỏi tôi: "Hỡi con người, những xương này có thể sống lại không?" Tôi thưa: "Lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chỉ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết điều đó."
vi.R: Ngài hỏi tôi: "Hỡi con người, những xương này có thể sống lại được không?" Tôi thưa: "Lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chỉ có {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mới biết điều đó."

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "사람의 아들아, 이 뼈들이 살 수 있겠느냐?" 그래서 내가 말했다. "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님께서 아십니다."
ko.B: 그분께서 나에게 물으셨다. "사람의 아들아, 이 뼈들이 살아날 수 있겠느냐?" 내가 대답했다. "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님만이 아십니다."
ko.R: 그분께서 나에게 물으셨다. "사람의 아들아, 이 뼈들이 다시 살아날 수 있겠느냐?" 내가 대답했다. "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 그것은 주님만 아십니다."

decisions.choice: Lord GOD, you know: the answer leaves it to the LORD
decisions.reason: Ezekiel neither says yes nor no. By human reckoning the answer is no; only the LORD knows what he can do. The Hebrew stresses "you": you yourself know.

decisions.choice: will these bones live: can they come to life again
decisions.reason: The verb "live" runs through the passage (verses 5, 6, 9, 10, 14). The question is whether the dead can live.

decisions.choice: only you know (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew stresses "you" by adding the pronoun. Balanced and Readable say "only you" to carry the stress. "Lord GOD" is *Adonai YHWH*, as set for Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "toi, tu le sais" (L); "toi seul le sais" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew stresses the pronoun; French marks it with "toi", under the deity_pronoun setting, and the vision's dialogue takes « » as narrative speech does.

decisions.choice: "«...»" for the dialogue of the vision; Ezekiel says "tú" to God ("Señor DIOS, tú lo sabes")
decisions.reason: Narrative dialogue in the visions takes « » as the terms note sets it, and the prophet speaks to God with "tú".

decisions.choice: spans on "wewe" and "yako" when Ezekiel speaks to God; the vocative "Ee Bwana MUNGU"
decisions.reason: The address forms of the term sheet: God is "wewe", and spans go only on free pronouns and possessives.

decisions.choice: God speaks with "phán" and "Ngài" (spanned mid-sentence); Ezekiel answers "Lạy Chúa là CHÚA, (chỉ) Ngài biết"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form for 37:3 and its address: Ezekiel calls God "Ngài" and "Lạy Chúa là CHÚA"; God calls him "con người". "Chỉ" (only) is added at B and R, as the English adds "only".

decisions.choice: "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님께서 아십니다" (L); "…주님만이 아십니다" (B); "…그것은 주님만 아십니다" (R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel speaks to God in 합쇼체 and calls him by the bare title, since no vocative particle reads after both forms of the span; this is the wording the term sheet sets for this verse.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל־הָעֲצָמ֣וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם הָעֲצָמוֹת֙ הַיְבֵשׁ֔וֹת שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, Prophesy over these bones and say to them, Dry bones, hear [the] word of Yahweh.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to me, "Prophesy over these bones, and say to them, Dry bones, hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to me, "Prophesy over these bones and say to them, Dry bones, hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to me, "Prophesy to these bones. Tell them, Dry bones, listen to what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says!

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me dit : « Prophétise sur ces ossements, et dis-leur : Ossements desséchés, écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me dit : « Prophétise sur ces ossements et dis-leur : Ossements desséchés, écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Ensuite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a dit : « Prophétise à ces ossements. Dis-leur : Ossements desséchés, écoutez ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !

es.L: Y me dijo: «Profetiza sobre estos huesos, y diles: Huesos secos, {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Entonces me dijo: «Profetiza sobre estos huesos y diles: ¡Huesos secos, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}!

decisions.choice: breath: *ruach*, one word for breath, wind and Spirit
decisions.reason: The Hebrew *ruach* means wind, breath and spirit, and verses 1-14 use all three senses of it. It is the Spirit of the LORD who carries Ezekiel (verse 1); breath that enters the bodies and makes them live (verses 5-6, 8-10); the four winds from which the breath is called (verse 9); and the LORD's own Spirit, which he will put in his people (verse 14). The passage plays on the one word: the breath that makes the bodies live comes from the winds and stands for the Spirit of God. The breath of life recalls Genesis 2:7, where God breathes into the man he has formed, and Psalm 104:29-30. Each verse states which sense it gives; the reader should know that behind all of them stands one Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: I will make breath enter you, and you will live: Genesis 2:7
decisions.reason: As God formed the man from dust and breathed into him the breath of life (Genesis 2:7), so here he first rebuilds the bodies (verses 6-8) and then gives them breath (verses 9-10). The restoration of Israel is pictured as a new creation.

decisions.choice: breath (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: Here *ruach* is the breath of life that makes a body live, so every level says "breath" (m1). Readable says "come back to life" for "live", since the bones were dead. The formula follows 2:4.

decisions.reason: French has no single word for the three senses; each verse takes the sense its English record states, and the English footnote names the play.

decisions.reason: Swahili has no single word for breath, wind and Spirit, so each verse uses the word for the sense the English chooses, and the footnoted meaning decision names the play on ruach.

decisions.choice: ruach in 37:1-14: "hơi thở" (breath), "gió" (wind) or "Thần Linh" (Spirit), each verse choosing its sense
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has no one word for the three senses of ruach, so each verse says the sense the English and the meaning decisions choose; the footnoted meaning decision at this verse names the play. "Hơi thở" is plainer than "sinh khí" and keeps the link with breathing in verse 9.

decisions.reason: Ruach in 37:1-14 is chosen verse by verse, as the English does and the term sheet sets; "생기" is not used. The footnoted meaning decision names the play on the one Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: sinews: the tendons and ligaments that hold the body together
decisions.reason: The word means the cords that bind muscle to bone (Job 10:11). The bodies are rebuilt in order: sinews, flesh, skin, and last of all breath.

decisions.choice: sinews, flesh, skin, breath: Job 10:11
decisions.reason: Job describes his own making in the same order: "You clothed me with skin and flesh and knit me together with bones and sinews" (Job 10:11).

decisions.choice: breath; the refrain as settled
decisions.reason: *Ruach* is "breath" here, as in verse 5. The refrain follows the settled wording. Readable says "muscles" for "flesh", since the word means the body's flesh. The closing quotation mark ends the LORD's words to Ezekiel begun in verse 4.

records.literal_gloss: And I prophesied as I was commanded; and there was a sound as I prophesied, and look, a rattling, and the bones came together, bone to its bone.

en.L: And I prophesied just as I had been commanded; and there was a sound as I prophesied, and look, a rattling, and the bones came together, bone to its bone.
en.B: So I prophesied as I had been told. While I was prophesying, there was a noise, a rattling sound, and the bones came together, each bone to its own bone.
en.R: So I did what I was told and prophesied. While I was speaking, I heard a noise, a loud rattling. The bones began to come together. Each bone joined the bone it belonged to.

fr.L: Et je prophétisai comme j’en avais reçu l’ordre ; et il y eut un bruit pendant que je prophétisais, et voici, un fracas, et les ossements se rapprochèrent, un os de son os.
fr.B: Je prophétisai donc comme on me l’avait ordonné. Pendant que je prophétisais, il y eut un bruit, un cliquetis, et les ossements se rapprochèrent, chaque os de l’os qui lui correspondait.
fr.R: Alors j’ai fait ce qu’on m’avait dit et j’ai prophétisé. Pendant que je parlais, j’ai entendu un bruit, un grand cliquetis. Les ossements ont commencé à se rapprocher. Chaque os s’est joint à l’os auquel il appartenait.

es.L: Y profeticé como se me había mandado; y hubo un ruido mientras yo profetizaba, y he aquí, un estruendo, y los huesos se juntaron, cada hueso con su hueso.
es.B: Así que profeticé como se me había ordenado. Mientras profetizaba, se oyó un ruido, un estruendo, y los huesos se juntaron, cada hueso con el suyo.
es.R: Así que hice lo que se me dijo y profeticé. Mientras hablaba, oí un ruido, un gran estruendo. Los huesos comenzaron a juntarse. Cada hueso se unió al hueso que le correspondía.

sw.L: Nikatabiri sawasawa na nilivyoagizwa; kukawa na sauti nilipokuwa nikitabiri, na tazama, mgongano, nayo mifupa ikasogeleana, mfupa mmoja kwa mfupa wake.
sw.B: Basi nikatabiri kama nilivyoagizwa. Nilipokuwa nikitabiri, kukawa na kelele, sauti ya kugongana, nayo mifupa ikakutana, kila mfupa na mfupa wake.
sw.R: Basi nikafanya kama nilivyoambiwa, nikatabiri. Nilipokuwa nikisema, nikasikia kelele, sauti kubwa ya kugongana. Mifupa ikaanza kukutana. Kila mfupa ukaungana na mfupa ulioufaa.

vi.L: Và tôi đã nói tiên tri như tôi đã được truyền; và có tiếng động khi tôi đang nói tiên tri, và nầy, một tiếng lách cách, và các xương nhập lại với nhau, xương này với xương kia.
vi.B: Vậy tôi nói tiên tri như tôi đã được truyền. Khi tôi đang nói tiên tri thì có tiếng động, tiếng lách cách, và các xương ráp lại với nhau, xương nào vào xương nấy.
vi.R: Vậy tôi làm theo lời đã truyền cho tôi và nói tiên tri. Trong khi tôi đang nói thì tôi nghe có tiếng động, tiếng lách cách rất lớn. Các xương bắt đầu ráp lại với nhau. Mỗi xương nối vào đúng chỗ của nó.

ko.L: 그래서 나는 명령을 받은 대로 예언하였다. 내가 예언할 때에 소리가 났는데, 보라, 덜거덕거리는 소리였다. 그리고 뼈들이 서로 다가와, 뼈가 제 뼈에 [붙었다].
ko.B: 그래서 나는 명령을 받은 대로 예언했다. 내가 예언하는 동안에 소리가 났다. 덜거덕거리는 소리와 함께 뼈들이 서로 다가와, 뼈마다 제 뼈에 맞붙었다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 들은 대로 예언했다. 내가 말하고 있는데, 어떤 소리가 들렸다. 요란하게 덜거덕거리는 소리였다. 뼈들이 서로 모이기 시작했다. 뼈마다 제자리의 뼈에 가서 붙었다.

decisions.choice: a rattling: a shaking, a clattering noise
decisions.reason: The word *ra'ash* means shaking or quaking, and it is used of earthquakes (38:19; Amos 1:1). Here it is the clatter of the bones coming together.

decisions.choice: I prophesied as I was commanded: Ezekiel's obedience
decisions.reason: The prophet does exactly what he is told (12:7; 24:18), and the LORD's word does what it says (Isaiah 55:10-11).

decisions.choice: a rattling (L, B); a loud rattling (R)
decisions.reason: Each level says "rattling" for the sound, not "earthquake", since the bones are the subject.

decisions.choice: "un estruendo" (L, B); "un gran estruendo" (R)
decisions.reason: Ra'ash is a shaking and clattering noise; "estruendo" carries both.

source.text: וְרָאִ֜יתִי וְהִנֵּֽה־עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם גִּדִים֙ וּבָשָׂ֣ר עָלָ֔ה וַיִּקְרַ֧ם עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם ע֖וֹר מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְר֖וּחַ אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I looked, and look, on them sinews, and flesh came up, and skin covered over them above; but breath there was none in them.

en.L: And I looked, and look, there were sinews on them, and flesh had come up, and skin had covered them over; but there was no breath in them.
en.B: As I watched, tendons appeared on them, flesh grew on them, and skin covered them over. But there was no breath in them.
en.R: As I watched, tendons and muscles grew on the bones, and skin covered them. But they were not breathing.

fr.L: Et je regardai, et voici, sur eux [il y avait] des tendons, et la chair était montée, et la peau les avait recouverts par-dessus ; mais il n’y avait pas de souffle en eux.
fr.B: Je regardai : des tendons apparurent sur eux, la chair poussa, et la peau les recouvrit. Mais il n’y avait pas de souffle en eux.
fr.R: Pendant que je regardais, des tendons et des muscles ont poussé sur les ossements, et la peau les a recouverts. Mais ils ne respiraient pas.

es.L: Y miré, y he aquí, había tendones sobre ellos, y subió la carne, y la piel los cubrió por encima; pero no había aliento en ellos.
es.B: Mientras yo miraba, aparecieron tendones sobre ellos, les creció carne y la piel los cubrió. Pero no había aliento en ellos.
es.R: Mientras yo miraba, les crecieron a los huesos tendones y músculos, y la piel los cubrió. Pero no respiraban.

sw.L: Nikatazama, na tazama, mishipa juu yake, na nyama ikapanda, na ngozi ikaifunika juu; lakini pumzi haikuwamo ndani yake.
sw.B: Nilipokuwa nikitazama, mishipa ikatokea juu yake, nyama ikaota juu yake, na ngozi ikaifunika. Lakini haikuwa na pumzi ndani yake.
sw.R: Nilipokuwa nikitazama, mishipa na misuli ikaota juu ya mifupa, na ngozi ikaifunika. Lakini miili hiyo haikuwa ikipumua.

vi.L: Và tôi nhìn, và nầy, có gân trên chúng, và thịt đã mọc lên, và da đã bọc chúng ở bên trên; nhưng không có hơi thở trong chúng.
vi.B: Tôi nhìn thì thấy gân xuất hiện trên chúng, thịt mọc lên và da bọc bên ngoài. Nhưng chúng chưa có hơi thở.
vi.R: Tôi nhìn thấy gân và bắp thịt mọc lên trên các xương, và da bọc chúng lại. Nhưng chúng chưa thở.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 보니, 보라, 그것들 위에 힘줄이 있었고, 살이 올라왔으며, 그 위로 살갗이 덮였다. 그러나 그것들 속에 숨은 없었다.
ko.B: 내가 지켜보니, 뼈들 위에 힘줄이 생기고 살이 오르고, 그 위를 살갗이 덮었다. 그러나 그 속에 숨은 없었다.
ko.R: 내가 지켜보니, 뼈들 위에 힘줄과 살이 생겨나고, 살갗이 그 위를 덮었다. 그러나 그들은 숨을 쉬지 않았다.

decisions.choice: there was no breath in them: bodies without life
decisions.reason: The bodies are whole, but they are still corpses. Rebuilding them is not enough; they need breath, the gift of life from God. The step echoes Genesis 2:7, where the man is formed before he receives the breath of life.

decisions.choice: breath (L, B); they were not breathing (R)
decisions.reason: *Ruach* is "breath" here, as in verses 5-6.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־הָר֑וּחַ הִנָּבֵ֣א בֶן־אָ֠דָם וְאָמַרְתָּ֨אֶל־הָר֜וּחַ כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר׀אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה מֵאַרְבַּ֤ע רוּחוֹת֙ בֹּ֣אִי הָר֔וּחַ וּפְחִ֛י בַּהֲרוּגִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְיִֽחְיֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: From [the] four winds come, breath, and breathe into these slain, so that they may live.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told me, "Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and you will say to the breath, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: From the four winds come, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live."
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told me, "Prophesy to the breath. Prophesy, son of man, and say to it, The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe into these slain, so that they may live."
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to me, "Son of man, prophesy to the breath. Say to it, This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: Breath, come from the four winds! Breathe into these people who were killed, so that they may live again."

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me dit : « Prophétise au souffle ; prophétise, fils d’homme, et tu diras au souffle : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Des quatre vents viens, souffle, et souffle sur ces tués, et qu’ils vivent. »
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me dit : « Prophétise au souffle. Prophétise, fils d’homme, et dis-lui : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Viens des quatre vents, souffle, et souffle dans ces morts, pour qu’ils vivent. »
fr.R: Ensuite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a dit : « Fils d’homme, prophétise au souffle. Dis-lui : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Souffle, viens des quatre vents ! Souffle dans ces gens qui ont été tués, pour qu’ils revivent. »

es.L: Y me dijo: «Profetiza al aliento; profetiza, hijo de hombre, y di al aliento: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Ven de los cuatro vientos, oh aliento, y sopla sobre estos muertos, para que vivan».
es.B: Entonces me dijo: «Profetiza al aliento. Profetiza, hijo de hombre, y dile: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Ven de los cuatro vientos, oh aliento, y sopla en estos muertos, para que vivan».
es.R: Entonces me dijo: «Hijo de hombre, profetiza al aliento. Dile: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Aliento, ven de los cuatro vientos. Sopla en estas personas que fueron asesinadas, para que vuelvan a vivir».

sw.L: Akaniambia, "Itabirie pumzi; tabiri, mwana wa binadamu, nawe utaiambia pumzi, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Njoo kutoka pepo nne, ewe pumzi, uwapulizie hawa waliouawa, ili wapate kuishi."
sw.B: Kisha akaniambia, "Itabirie pumzi. Tabiri, mwana wa binadamu, uiambie, Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Njoo kutoka pepo nne, ewe pumzi, uwapulizie hawa waliouawa, ili wawe hai."
sw.R: Kisha akaniambia, "Mwana wa binadamu, itabirie pumzi. Iambie, Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Ewe pumzi, njoo kutoka pepo nne! Uwapulizie watu hawa waliouawa, ili wawe hai tena."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán với tôi: "Hãy nói tiên tri với hơi thở; hãy nói tiên tri, hỡi con người, và ngươi sẽ nói với hơi thở: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Hỡi hơi thở, hãy đến từ bốn phương gió, và hãy thổi trên những người bị giết này để họ được sống."
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán với tôi: "Hãy nói tiên tri với hơi thở. Hỡi con người, hãy nói tiên tri và bảo hơi thở: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Hỡi hơi thở, hãy đến từ bốn phương gió và thổi vào những người bị giết này để họ được sống."
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán với tôi: "Hỡi con người, hãy nói tiên tri với hơi thở. Hãy bảo nó: Đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Hỡi hơi thở, hãy đến từ bốn phương gió! Hãy thổi vào những người đã bị giết này để họ được sống lại."

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "숨에게 예언하여라. 사람의 아들아, 예언하여 숨에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 숨아, 사방의 바람에서 불어와서 이 죽임당한 자들에게 불어라. 그들이 살 것이다."
ko.B: 그러자 그분께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "숨에게 예언하여라. 사람의 아들아, 예언하여 숨에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 숨아, 사방에서 불어오너라. 이 죽임당한 사람들에게 불어 그들이 살아나게 하여라."
ko.R: 그러자 그분께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "사람의 아들아, 숨에게 예언하여라. 숨에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 숨아, 사방에서 불어오너라! 이 죽임당한 사람들에게 불어서, 그들이 다시 살아나게 하여라."

decisions.choice: the breath ... the four winds: the same word in two senses
decisions.reason: Ezekiel speaks to the *ruach* as breath and calls it from the four *ruchot*, the four winds, that is, from every direction (42:20; Daniel 8:8). The wind becomes breath for the bodies. The play prepares for verse 14, where the LORD says the life he gives is his own Spirit. Jesus uses the same play on wind and Spirit in John 3:8.

decisions.choice: these slain: people killed in battle
decisions.reason: The word means those who have been killed. The bones are the remains of a slaughtered people, Israel destroyed by war and exile (verse 11).

decisions.choice: breath (L, B, R); winds (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: Each level says "breath" for the *ruach* that is addressed and "winds" for the four directions (m1). Literal says "breathe on", Balanced and Readable "breathe into". The message takes no quotation marks of its own, as in verse 4.

decisions.choice: "ces morts" (B) for "these slain"
decisions.reason: "Tués" alone is awkward in careful French; "morts" with the context of the battlefield says it; L keeps the participle.

decisions.choice: "Ven de los cuatro vientos, oh aliento" (L, B); "Aliento, ven de los cuatro vientos" (R)
decisions.reason: The vocative as the terms note sets it; "aliento" and "vientos" keep the two senses of ruach apart.

decisions.choice: "hơi thở" ... "bốn phương gió"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses ruach for both the breath and the winds; Vietnamese must use two words, so the play is left to the footnoted meaning decision. "Bốn phương gió" is the published form for the four winds (Matthew 24:31). The slain are "họ": they are about to live.

source.text: וְהִנַּבֵּ֖אתִי כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֑נִי וַתָּבוֹא֩ בָהֶ֨ם הָר֜וּחַ וַיִּֽחְי֗וּ וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ עַל־רַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם חַ֖יִל גָּד֥וֹל מְאֹד־מְאֹֽד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived and stood on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

en.L: And I prophesied just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had commanded me, and into them came the breath, and they lived, and they stood on their feet, an exceedingly great army.
en.B: So I prophesied as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had commanded me, and breath entered them. They came to life and stood up on their feet, a huge army.
en.R: So I prophesied as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told me to. Breath came into the bodies, and they came back to life. They stood up on their feet. There were so many of them that they were like a huge army.

fr.L: Et je prophétisai comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me l’avait ordonné, et le souffle entra en eux, et ils vécurent, et ils se tinrent sur leurs pieds, une armée très, très grande.
fr.B: Je prophétisai donc comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me l’avait ordonné, et le souffle entra en eux. Ils reprirent vie et se dressèrent sur leurs pieds : c’était une armée immense.
fr.R: Alors j’ai prophétisé comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me l’avait dit. Le souffle est entré dans les corps, et ils sont revenus à la vie. Ils se sont mis debout. Ils étaient si nombreux qu’on aurait dit une immense armée.

es.L: Y profeticé como me había mandado, y entró en ellos el aliento, y vivieron, y se pusieron en pie, un ejército grande en extremo.
es.B: Así que profeticé como me lo había ordenado, y el aliento entró en ellos. Cobraron vida y se pusieron en pie: un ejército enorme.
es.R: Así que profeticé como me lo había dicho. El aliento entró en los cuerpos, y volvieron a la vida. Se pusieron en pie. Eran tantos que parecían un ejército enorme.

sw.L: Nikatabiri sawasawa na alivyoniagiza, nayo pumzi ikaingia ndani yao, wakaishi, wakasimama kwa miguu yao, jeshi kubwa sana kupita kiasi.
sw.B: Basi nikatabiri kama alivyoniagiza, nayo pumzi ikaingia ndani yao. Wakawa hai, wakasimama kwa miguu yao, jeshi kubwa mno.
sw.R: Basi nikatabiri kama alivyoniambia. Pumzi ikaingia ndani ya miili hiyo, nayo ikawa hai tena. Wakasimama kwa miguu yao. Walikuwa wengi mno, kama jeshi kubwa sana.

vi.L: Và tôi đã nói tiên tri như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền cho tôi, và hơi thở đã vào trong họ, và họ sống, và họ đứng dậy trên chân mình, một đạo quân rất, rất lớn.
vi.B: Vậy tôi nói tiên tri như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền cho tôi, và hơi thở vào trong họ. Họ sống lại và đứng dậy trên chân mình, thành một đạo quân rất đông.
vi.R: Vậy tôi nói tiên tri như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bảo tôi. Hơi thở vào trong các thân thể ấy, và họ sống lại. Họ đứng dậy trên chân mình. Họ đông đến nỗi giống như một đạo quân rất lớn.

ko.L: 그래서 나는 그분께서 나에게 명령하신 대로 예언하였다. 그러자 숨이 그들 속에 들어갔고, 그들이 살아나 자기 발로 일어섰다. 매우 큰 군대였다.
ko.B: 그래서 나는 그분께서 명령하신 대로 예언했다. 그러자 숨이 그들 속에 들어갔다. 그들은 살아나서 자기 발로 일어섰다. 엄청나게 큰 군대였다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 그분께서 말씀하신 대로 예언했다. 그러자 숨이 그 몸들 속에 들어갔고, 그들은 다시 살아났다. 그들은 자기 발로 일어섰다. 그 수가 얼마나 많은지 큰 군대 같았다.

decisions.choice: an army: a great host
decisions.reason: The word *chayil* means strength, and so an army. The dead have become a living host, a people again.

decisions.choice: they lived and stood on their feet: as Ezekiel himself was raised
decisions.reason: The Spirit set Ezekiel on his feet in 2:2 and 3:24. Now the people, too, are raised up. Revelation 11:11 uses the words of this verse for the two witnesses: "the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet".

decisions.choice: breath (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: *Ruach* is "breath" here, as in verses 5-9. Readable adds "like" to make the picture plain.

source.text: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ אֵלַי֒ בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הָעֲצָמ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה כָּל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵ֑מָּה הִנֵּ֣ה אֹמְרִ֗ים יָבְשׁ֧וּ עַצְמוֹתֵ֛ינוּ וְאָבְדָ֥ה תִקְוָתֵ֖נוּ נִגְזַ֥רְנוּ לָֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, Son of man, these bones, they [are] the whole house of Israel. Look, they are saying, Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost; we are cut off.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to me, "Son of man, these bones, they [are] the whole house of Israel. Look, they are saying, 'Dried up are our bones, and perished is our hope; we are cut off completely.'
en.B: He said to me, "Son of man, these bones stand for the whole house of Israel. They keep saying, 'Our bones have dried up, our hope is gone; we are completely cut off.'
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to me, "Son of man, these bones are all the people of Israel. They say, 'Our bones are dried up. We have no hope left. We are finished.'

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me dit : « Fils d’homme, ces ossements, ils [sont] toute la maison d’Israël. Voici, ils disent : “Desséchés sont nos os, et perdue est notre espérance ; nous sommes complètement retranchés.”
fr.B: Il me dit : « Fils d’homme, ces ossements représentent toute la maison d’Israël. Ils ne cessent de dire : “Nos os se sont desséchés, notre espérance a disparu ; nous sommes complètement retranchés.”
fr.R: Ensuite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a dit : « Fils d’homme, ces ossements, c’est tout le peuple d’Israël. Ils disent : “Nos os sont desséchés. Nous n’avons plus d’espoir. C’est la fin pour nous.”

es.L: Y me dijo: «Hijo de hombre, estos huesos, ellos [son] toda la casa de Israel. He aquí, ellos dicen: “Se secaron nuestros huesos, y pereció nuestra esperanza; estamos del todo cortados”.
es.B: Me dijo: «Hijo de hombre, estos huesos representan a toda la casa de Israel. No dejan de decir: “Nuestros huesos se han secado, ya no tenemos esperanza; estamos completamente perdidos”.
es.R: Entonces me dijo: «Hijo de hombre, estos huesos son todo el pueblo de Israel. Ellos dicen: “Nuestros huesos están secos. Ya no nos queda esperanza. Estamos acabados”.

sw.L: Akaniambia, "Mwana wa binadamu, mifupa hii, hiyo [ni] nyumba yote ya Israeli. Tazama, wanasema, 'Imekauka mifupa yetu, na limetoweka tumaini letu; tumekatwa kabisa.'
sw.B: Akaniambia, "Mwana wa binadamu, mifupa hii inawakilisha nyumba yote ya Israeli. Wanasema daima, 'Mifupa yetu imekauka, tumaini letu limetoweka; tumeangamia kabisa.'
sw.R: Kisha akaniambia, "Mwana wa binadamu, mifupa hii ni watu wote wa Israeli. Wanasema, 'Mifupa yetu imekauka. Hatuna tumaini tena. Tumekwisha.'

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán với tôi: "Hỡi con người, những xương này, chúng [là] cả nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên. Nầy, chúng đang nói: 'Xương cốt chúng ta đã khô, và hy vọng chúng ta đã mất; chúng ta bị dứt bỏ hoàn toàn.'
vi.B: Ngài phán với tôi: "Hỡi con người, những xương này là cả nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên. Chúng cứ nói: 'Xương cốt chúng ta đã khô, hy vọng chúng ta đã tiêu tan; chúng ta bị dứt bỏ hoàn toàn rồi.'
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán với tôi: "Hỡi con người, những xương này là toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ nói: 'Xương cốt chúng ta đã khô. Chúng ta không còn hy vọng gì nữa. Chúng ta tiêu đời rồi.'

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "사람의 아들아, 이 뼈들, 이것들은 이스라엘 온 집이다. 보라, 그들이 말하고 있다. '우리 뼈가 말랐고, 우리 소망이 사라졌다. 우리는 완전히 끊어졌다.'
ko.B: 그분께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "사람의 아들아, 이 뼈들은 이스라엘 온 집을 가리킨다. 그들은 늘 '우리 뼈가 말라 버렸고, 우리 소망은 사라졌다. 우리는 완전히 끊어졌다' 하고 말한다.
ko.R: 그러자 그분께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "사람의 아들아, 이 뼈들은 모든 이스라엘 백성이다. 그들은 '우리 뼈가 말라 버렸다. 우리에게는 아무 소망도 없다. 우리는 이제 끝났다' 하고 말한다.

decisions.choice: these bones are the whole house of Israel: the vision explained
decisions.reason: The vision is not about individual people raised from the dead but about the nation, dead in exile, which the LORD will bring back to life and to its land (verses 12-14). "The whole house of Israel" includes both kingdoms (verses 15-22).

decisions.choice: our bones are dried up; we are cut off: the exiles' despair
decisions.reason: The people speak as if they were dead already, with no strength and no future (compare Psalm 31:11; Proverbs 17:22; Lamentations 3:54). The vision takes their own words and answers them.

decisions.choice: cut off completely (L); completely cut off (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew adds "for ourselves", which stresses the verb. The people's words are quoted inside the LORD's words, so they take single quotation marks inside the double ones.

decisions.choice: the quotation opened here runs to the end of verse 14
decisions.reason: God's explanation continues across verses 11-14 as one speech; the people's words inside it take “ ”.

decisions.choice: “ ” for the people's words inside God's speech
decisions.reason: Speech quoted inside a quotation takes “ ” inside « », as the Spanish of these books stores it.

decisions.choice: "chúng" (L, B) / "họ" (R) for the despairing exiles
decisions.reason: The people in their despair are still under judgment, so Literal and Balanced keep "chúng" until the promise of verse 12; Readable uses the neutral "họ", which plain Vietnamese prefers for people one pities.

decisions.choice: "소망" for tiqvah, at every level
decisions.reason: The word the Korean prophets and the New Testament use for hope in God; Readable keeps it, as it is a common word.

source.text: לָכֵן֩ הִנָּבֵ֨א וְאָמַרְתָּ֜ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּה֩ אֲנִ֨י פֹתֵ֜חַ אֶת־קִבְרֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהַעֲלֵיתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִקִּבְרוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם עַמִּ֑י וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Therefore prophesy and say to them, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Look, I am opening your graves, and I will bring you up from your graves, my people, and bring you into [the] land of Israel.

en.L: Therefore prophesy, and say to them, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Look, I am going to open your graves and bring you up from your graves, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, and bring you into the land of Israel.
en.B: So prophesy and say to them, The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: I am going to open your graves and raise you up out of them, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. I will bring you into the land of Israel.
en.R: So prophesy to them. Tell them, This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: My people, I am going to open your graves and bring you up out of them. I will bring you back to the land of Israel.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi prophétise, et dis-leur : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Voici, je vais ouvrir vos tombeaux, et je vous ferai monter de vos tombeaux, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et je vous ferai venir dans le pays d’Israël.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi prophétise et dis-leur : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je vais ouvrir vos tombeaux et vous en faire remonter, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. Je vous ferai venir dans le pays d’Israël.
fr.R: Alors prophétise. Dis-leur : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Mon peuple, je vais ouvrir vos tombes et vous en faire sortir. Je vous ramènerai dans le pays d’Israël.

es.L: Por tanto, profetiza y diles: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: He aquí, yo abro {{plural_you:sus sepulcros|vuestros sepulcros}}, y {{plural_you:los|os}} haré subir de {{plural_you:sus sepulcros|vuestros sepulcros}}, pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, y {{plural_you:los|os}} traeré a la tierra de Israel.
es.B: Por eso, profetiza y diles: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Voy a abrir {{plural_you:sus sepulcros|vuestros sepulcros}} y {{plural_you:los|os}} haré salir de ellos, pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} traeré a la tierra de Israel.
es.R: Así que profetiza y diles: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, voy a abrir {{plural_you:sus tumbas|vuestras tumbas}} y {{plural_you:los|os}} sacaré de ellas. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} traeré de vuelta a la tierra de Israel.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo tabiri, uwaambie, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninakwenda kufungua makaburi yenu, na kuwapandisha kutoka makaburini mwenu, enyi watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, na kuwaleta katika nchi ya Israeli.
sw.B: Basi tabiri, uwaambie, Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Nitafungua makaburi yenu na kuwainua kutoka humo, enyi watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Nitawaleta katika nchi ya Israeli.
sw.R: Basi watabirie. Waambie, Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Enyi watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nitafungua makaburi yenu na kuwatoa humo. Nitawarudisha katika nchi ya Israeli.

vi.L: Vì vậy hãy nói tiên tri và nói với chúng: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Nầy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mở các mồ mả của các ngươi và đem các ngươi lên khỏi mồ mả mình, hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem các ngươi vào đất Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vậy hãy nói tiên tri và bảo họ: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mở các mồ mả của các ngươi và đem các ngươi lên khỏi đó. Ta sẽ đưa các ngươi vào đất Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vậy hãy nói tiên tri cho họ. Hãy bảo họ: Đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mở các mồ mả của các ngươi và đem các ngươi lên khỏi đó. Ta sẽ đưa các ngươi trở về đất Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그러므로 예언하여 그들에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 보라, 내 백성아, 내가 너희 무덤을 열고, 너희를 너희 무덤에서 올라오게 하여, 이스라엘 땅으로 데려가겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 예언하여 그들에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내 백성아, 내가 너희 무덤을 열고 너희를 거기서 일으켜 올리겠다. 내가 너희를 이스라엘 땅으로 데려가겠다.
ko.R: 그러니 그들에게 예언하여라. 그들에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 내 백성아, 내가 너희 무덤을 열고 너희를 거기서 끌어올리겠다. 내가 너희를 이스라엘 땅으로 다시 데려가겠다.

decisions.choice: I will open your graves: the return from exile pictured as resurrection
decisions.reason: The picture changes from bones in a valley to bodies in graves, but the meaning is the same: the LORD will bring his people back from the death of exile to their land. The passage does not set out a teaching about the resurrection of the body, but it shows the LORD as the one who can raise the dead, and later Scripture speaks of a bodily resurrection in similar words (Isaiah 26:19; Daniel 12:2; John 5:28-29).

decisions.choice: my people: the people the LORD still claims
decisions.reason: The LORD calls the despairing exiles "my people" (verse 13). His covenant with them is not over.

decisions.choice: Thus says the Lord GOD (L); The Lord GOD says this (B); This is what the Lord GOD says (R)
decisions.reason: The formula as set at 2:4. The message takes no quotation marks of its own, as in verse 4. Readable starts a new sentence with "My people", where the pronoun is capitalized under either setting.

decisions.choice: plural "you" to the people through verse 14 ("{{plural_you:sus sepulcros|vuestros sepulcros}}")
decisions.reason: The people are addressed in the plural.

records.literal_gloss: And you will know that I [am] Yahweh, when I open your graves and when I bring you up from your graves, my people.

en.L: And you will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I open up your graves and when I bring you up out of your graves, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people.
en.B: Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, when I open your graves and raise you up out of them.
en.R: Then, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I open up your graves and lift you out of them.

fr.L: Et vous saurez que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand j’ouvrirai vos tombeaux et quand je vous ferai monter de vos tombeaux, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple.
fr.B: Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, quand j’ouvrirai vos tombeaux et que je vous en ferai remonter.
fr.R: Alors, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand j’ouvrirai vos tombes et que je vous en ferai sortir.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando abra {{plural_you:sus sepulcros|vuestros sepulcros}} y cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} haga subir de {{plural_you:sus sepulcros|vuestros sepulcros}}, pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}.
es.B: Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, cuando abra {{plural_you:sus sepulcros|vuestros sepulcros}} y {{plural_you:los|os}} haga salir de ellos.
es.R: Entonces, pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando abra {{plural_you:sus tumbas|vuestras tumbas}} y {{plural_you:los|os}} saque de ellas.

sw.L: Nanyi mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapofungua makaburi yenu, na nitakapowapandisha kutoka makaburini mwenu, enyi watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.B: Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nitakapofungua makaburi yenu na kuwainua kutoka humo.
sw.R: Ndipo, enyi watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapofungua makaburi yenu na kuwatoa humo.

vi.L: Và các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mở các mồ mả của các ngươi, và khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem các ngươi lên khỏi mồ mả mình, hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mở các mồ mả của các ngươi và đem các ngươi lên khỏi đó.
vi.R: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mở các mồ mả của các ngươi và đem các ngươi lên khỏi đó, khi ấy các ngươi sẽ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 내 백성아, 내가 너희 무덤을 열고 너희를 너희 무덤에서 올라오게 할 때에, 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 내 백성아, 내가 너희 무덤을 열고 너희를 거기서 일으켜 올릴 때, 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내 백성아, 내가 너희 무덤을 열고 너희를 거기서 끌어올릴 때, 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: you will know that I am the LORD: the refrain, after rescue
decisions.reason: See 6:7. Here the people come to know the LORD through his power to give life.

decisions.choice: the refrain as settled
decisions.reason: The settled wording of the refrain.

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֨י רוּחִ֤י בָכֶם֙ וִחְיִיתֶ֔ם וְהִנַּחְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם עַל־אַדְמַתְכֶ֑ם וִידַעְתֶּ֞ם כִּי־אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִׂ֖יתִי נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live, and I will set you on your land; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken and I will do [it], declares Yahweh.

en.L: And I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit within you, and you will live, and I will place you on your own soil; and you will know that I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken and will do [it], declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit within you so that you live, and I will set you down on your own soil. Then you will know that I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken and will act, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit in you, and you will live. I will let you live in your own country. Then you will know that I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have said this and will do it, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

fr.L: Et je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit en vous, et vous vivrez, et je vous établirai sur votre sol ; et vous saurez que moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé et je [le] ferai, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit en vous pour que vous viviez, et je vous installerai sur votre sol. Alors vous saurez que moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé et que j’agirai, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit en vous, et vous vivrez. Je vous ferai habiter dans votre pays. Alors vous saurez que moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai dit cela et que je le ferai, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

es.L: Y pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}}, y {{plural_you:los|os}} estableceré sobre {{plural_you:su propio suelo|vuestro propio suelo}}; y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he hablado y [lo] haré, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: Pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para que {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}}, y {{plural_you:los|os}} estableceré en {{plural_you:su propio suelo|vuestro propio suelo}}. es.R: Pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}}. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he dicho esto y lo haré, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

sw.L: Nami nitamtia Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ndani yenu, nanyi mtaishi, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawakalisha katika ardhi yenu wenyewe; nanyi mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema na nitatenda, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Nitamweka Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ndani yenu ili mpate kuwa hai, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawakalisha katika nchi yenu wenyewe. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema na nitatenda, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Nitamweka Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ndani yenu, nanyi mtakuwa hai. Nitawaacha mkae katika nchi yenu wenyewe. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema jambo hili na nitalifanya, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt Thần Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ sống, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt các ngươi trên đất của các ngươi; và các ngươi sẽ biết rằng chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán và sẽ làm [điều đó], {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy."
vi.B: Ta sẽ đặt Thần Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong các ngươi để các ngươi được sống, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho các ngươi định cư trên đất của mình. Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ biết rằng chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán và sẽ thực hiện, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy."
vi.R: Ta sẽ đặt Thần Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ sống. Ta sẽ cho các ngươi sống trên đất nước của mình. Khi ấy các ngươi sẽ biết rằng chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán điều này và sẽ làm điều đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán."

ko.L: 그리고 내가 내 영을 너희 속에 두겠으니, 너희가 살 것이다. 내가 너희를 너희 땅에 두겠다. 그리고 너희는 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말하였고 [그것을] 이룬 줄 알 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다."
ko.B: 내가 내 영을 너희 속에 두어 너희가 살게 하고, 너희를 너희 땅에 자리 잡게 하겠다. 그러면 너희는 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말하였고 그대로 이룬 줄 알게 될 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."
ko.R: 내가 내 영을 너희 속에 넣어 주면, 너희가 살 것이다. 내가 너희를 너희 땅에서 살게 하겠다. 그러면 너희는 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 이 말을 했고, 그대로 이룬 줄 알게 될 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."

decisions.choice: my Spirit: the LORD's own Spirit, the source of the people's new life
decisions.reason: The *ruach* that was breath in verses 5-10 is now named as the LORD's own Spirit. The same promise is given in 36:27 and 39:29. The people's new life is not their own strength but God's Spirit in them.

decisions.choice: declares the LORD: the name alone
decisions.reason: The formula here has the divine name alone, not "the Lord GOD", as in a few other places in the book.

decisions.choice: Spirit, capitalized; I, the LORD, have spoken; declares (L, B) / says (R) the LORD
decisions.reason: Here *ruach* is the LORD's own Spirit, capitalized by Isaiah's rule as at 2:2. "I, the LORD, have spoken" and *ne'um* follow the settled wording. The closing quotation mark ends the LORD's words begun in verse 9.

decisions.choice: "declara el SEÑOR" (L); "afirma el SEÑOR" (B); "dice el SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: Ne'um YHWH with the name alone, as the Isaiah and Jeremiah terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: "asema BWANA" (L, B); "anasema BWANA" (R), the name alone
decisions.reason: The formula ne'um YHWH without Adonai, as the Swahili prophets render it; Spirit is "Roho" with the capital and personal agreement, as in 36:27.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của Ta", capitalised
decisions.reason: Here ruach is God's own Spirit, the source of the people's new life (meaning decision), so it takes the term sheet's "Thần Linh", as 36:27.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다" (L); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew has the name alone (ne'um YHWH), so the Isaiah form for "declares the LORD" is used, not the Lord GOD form.

vi.B: Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với tôi:
